create_bylaw.title: Put a council bylaw on record
create_bylaw.description: Put one bylaw of the council on record: its title, the year it was made and its text.

list_bylaws.title: List council bylaws
list_bylaws.description: List the bylaws of one agency's council, earliest year first, optionally only one year's.

get_bylaw.title: Read a council bylaw
get_bylaw.description: Read one bylaw of one agency's council by its id.

create_meeting.title: Create a council meeting
create_meeting.description: Put one council or committee meeting on record: its name, the day it is held, where, and which committee holds it.

list_meetings.title: List council meetings
list_meetings.description: List the meetings of one agency's council, earliest day first, optionally only one committee's.

get_meeting.title: Read a council meeting
get_meeting.description: Read one meeting of one agency's council by its id.

set_agenda.title: Set a meeting's agenda
set_agenda.description: Set the items one council meeting will take up, in order. Setting it again replaces the items.

args.description: The meeting the agenda is for.

get_agenda.title: Read a meeting's agenda
get_agenda.description: Read the agenda of one meeting of one agency's council.

args.description: The meeting whose agenda to read.

set_minutes.title: Set a meeting's minutes
set_minutes.description: Set the written minutes of one council meeting. Setting them again replaces the text.

args.description: The meeting the minutes are for.

create_resolution.title: Put a council resolution on record
create_resolution.description: Put one decision of the council on record: its title, the day it was taken, its outcome (adopted, rejected or deferred) and optionally the meeting it was taken at.

list_resolutions.title: List council resolutions
list_resolutions.description: List the resolutions of one agency's council, earliest day first, optionally only those of one meeting or one outcome.

get_resolution.title: Read a council resolution
get_resolution.description: Read one resolution of one agency's council by its id.

update_meeting.title: Correct a council meeting
update_meeting.description: Correct one meeting of one agency's council: send its name, day, place and committee as they should now read. Whatever is left out is cleared, except the name and day, which are required.

update_resolution.title: Correct a council resolution
update_resolution.description: Correct one resolution of one agency's council: send its title, the day it was taken and its outcome (adopted, rejected or deferred) as they should now read. The meeting it was taken at stays as it was recorded.

update_bylaw.title: Correct a council bylaw
update_bylaw.description: Correct one bylaw of one agency's council: send its title, the year it was made and its text as they should now read.

get_minutes.title: Read a meeting's minutes
get_minutes.description: Read the minutes of one meeting of one agency's council.

args.description: The meeting whose minutes to read.
